report_title: Form 40-F Annual Report for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (incl. AIF, MD&A exhibits)
notes: FY2025 40-F filed 2026-03-26 (EDGAR accession 0001104659-26-035151). Totals include discontinued operations: 277,709 oz Au (87,489 Lindero + 152,426 Séguéla + 37,794 Yaramoko partial-year), 966,108 oz Ag (all Caylloma), 34.7M lbs Pb, 50.8M lbs Zn; consolidated production 317,001 GEO. Continuing-ops only Au = 239,915 oz. Consolidated cash cost $944/oz AuEq and AISC $1,870/oz AuEq (incl. discontinued). San Jose (Mexico, Ag-Au) sold Apr 11, 2025 after care and maintenance since late 2024 (reserves exhausted) — zero 2025 production; Yaramoko (Burkina Faso) sold May 12, 2025. pdf_path points to the EDGAR HTML MD&A exhibit (no standalone PDF published).

mines.mine_notes: Costs per gold oz; cash cost net of copper by-product credits. 6,471,573 t placed on leach pad. Q4 impacted by HPGR downtime in December.

mines.processing: Single-stage crushing, SAG mill, carbon-in-leach + gravity, electrowinning/smelt to gold doré
mines.mine_notes: Costs per gold oz. State of Côte d'Ivoire holds 10% free-carried interest; production/reserves shown on 100% basis. Sunbird underground reserves (3.467 Mt @ 3.60 g/t = 401 koz) estimated first time; underground mining subject to ministerial approval. Ore from Antenna, Ancien, Koula pits.

mines.processing: Flotation plant (1,500 tpd): silver-lead and zinc concentrates
mines.mine_notes: Costs per SILVER-EQUIVALENT oz (not per Ag oz). Also produced 50,761,436 lbs zinc (grade 4.55%, recovery 91%). Lead grade 3.10%, recovery 91.3%. Silver grade 65 g/t, recovery ~83.4%. 2025 production guidance AISC for Caylloma was $21.7-24.7/oz AgEq.

Sold to Soleil Resources International Ltd. on May 12, 2025 (gross proceeds $70.0M); reported as discontinued operations. Figures are partial-year (Jan 1 - May 12, 2025). 155,358 t milled, recovery 97.46%. Costs per gold oz.

Sold to JRC Ingenieria y Construccion S.A.C. on Apr 11, 2025 (gross proceeds $13.8M); discontinued operations. On care and maintenance since late 2024 after exhausting mineral reserves; zero production in 2025.

reserves_resources.notes: Open pit 12.494 Mt @ 2.84 g/t (1,142 koz) + Sunbird underground 3.467 Mt @ 3.60 g/t (401 koz). Updated Jan 20, 2026 technical report. Reported 100% basis.
STALE: latest disclosed in AIF is Dec 31, 2022 technical report (0.10% Cu also). Consolidated Dec 31, 2025 reserve update expected April 2026, not in this report.
Polymetallic: 2.78% Pb (63.6 kt), 4.04% Zn (92.5 kt). STALE: latest disclosed in AIF is Dec 31, 2023; consolidated Dec 31, 2025 update expected April 2026.
